name: Exp_UltraMFI_MMRec
summary: This EA trades based on an 'Ultra MFI' custom indicator, using Money Flow Index signals to identify momentum shifts and generate buy/sell entries. It incorporates a money management recommendation system (MMRec) for dynamic position sizing. The strategy opens positions when MFI crosses key overbought/oversold thresholds with confirmation filters.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义的'Ultra MFI'指标进行交易，利用资金流量指数信号识别动量变化并生成买卖入场信号。它集成了资金管理推荐系统（MMRec）用于动态仓位调整。当MFI穿越关键超买/超卖阈值并伴有确认过滤条件时，策略开仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Ultra MFI（资金流量指数）指标的动量信号，当MFI从超卖区域上穿时做多，从超买区域下穿时做空。入场条件依赖MFI指标穿越自定义的超买和超卖阈值，可能还结合了趋势方向过滤来避免逆势交易。出场条件包括固定止盈止损以及MFI反向信号平仓。仓位管理通过MMRec模块实现，根据账户余额和风险比例动态计算每手交易量。资金管理方面支持固定手数和百分比风险两种模式，但具体是否包含马丁格尔或加仓逻辑取决于参数配置。整体策略属于典型的动量反转混合型，在超买超卖区间捕捉趋势启动点。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on momentum signals from the Ultra MFI (Money Flow Index) indicator, going long when MFI crosses upward from oversold zones and going short when crossing downward from overbought zones. Entry conditions rely on the MFI indicator crossing customizable overbought and oversold thresholds, potentially combined with trend direction filters to avoid counter-trend trades. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels as well as closing positions on MFI reversal signals. Position sizing is handled through the MMRec module, which dynamically calculates lot size based on account balance and risk percentage. Money management supports both fixed lot and percentage risk modes, though whether it includes Martingale or position-adding logic depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy is a typical momentum-reversal hybrid type, capturing trend initiation points within overbought and oversold zones.

parameters.description_en: Risk percentage for dynamic position sizing

parameters.name: UseMMRec
parameters.description: 是否启用资金管理推荐

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description_en: TII calculation timeframe, 0 for current period

pros: 基于MFI资金流量指标，能较好反映市场买卖力量对比
集成MMRec资金管理模块，支持动态仓位计算，风险可控
提供超买超卖阈值参数化配置，适应不同市场环境
pros_en: Based on the MFI indicator which effectively reflects market buying and selling pressure dynamics
Integrated MMRec money management module supports dynamic position sizing with controllable risk
Parameterized overbought/oversold thresholds allow adaptation to different market conditions
cons: 单一指标策略，缺乏多维度信号确认，容易产生虚假信号
MFI在震荡市中频繁穿越阈值导致反复开仓平仓造成磨损
未发现明显的滑点和点差过滤机制，在低流动性环境下风险较大
cons_en: Single-indicator strategy lacks multi-dimensional signal confirmation, prone to false signals
MFI frequently crosses thresholds in ranging markets causing repeated open/close and transaction cost erosion
No apparent slippage or spread filter mechanism, posing higher risk in low-liquidity environments
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向）避免在震荡行情中频繁交易
加入点差和滑点过滤条件，减少不利市场条件下的交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets
Incorporate spread and slippage filter conditions to reduce trading under unfavorable market conditions

risk_points: 单一MFI指标在震荡市中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏点差过滤和交易时间过滤，可能在不利时段开仓
risk_points_en: Single MFI indicator prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, may open positions during unfavorable periods

The strategy opens positions when MFI crosses key overbought/oversold thresholds with confirmation filters.
